caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a beige or light tan background, showing three technical views of an ornate wall-mounted bracket. The largest view features a detailed side profile, highlighting the elaborate geometric and floral patterns that decorate the structural elements, including a scalloped, upward-facing basket-like holder with a supporting arm adorned with scrollwork and a turned vertical end post. Below this, the bracket is presented in a top-down view, revealing a circular, rosette-like decorative plate with multi-lobed edges and intricate symmetrical detailing radiating from the center. To the right of the side profile, there is a small, scaled illustration of the bracket in use, supporting a traditional oil lamp with a glass chimney and round base. Each view is precisely shaded to emphasize depth and texture. Fine lines and delicate shading techniques are used throughout the composition, and a small, linear scale is included in the lower left corner for reference. The name "Marie Famularo" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the outlined drawing area.
title: Lamp Bracket
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
